question: Pandit Ram Narayan, who was awarded the Pandit Bhimsen Joshi Lifetime Achievement Award for 2015–2016, is a _______ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sarangi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Ram Narayan is a legendary Indian sarangi player, known for elevating the sarangi from a primarily accompanying instrument to one that could stand on its own in solo classical performances.
 
• Born in **1927 in Udaipur, Rajasthan**, he began his musical journey at a young age and became a leading figure in Hindustani classical music.
 
• The sarangi, a bowed string instrument, is one of the most difficult Indian instruments to master due to its complex playing techniques.
 
• Over his career, he has also been awarded the Padma Bhushan in **2005 **and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in **1976**.
